# Lulox (Luciano Oliva Bianco)

> Luciano Oliva Bianco ("Lulox") builds AI agents and automations for companies and people, plus custom CRMs and internal tools, so teams stop doing repetitive work by hand. His main engines are Grok, Grok Bot and Hermes. Based in Buenos Aires, Argentina; works remotely with Latin America and worldwide, in Spanish or English. X: @LuloxDev. Site in Spanish at the root and in English under /en.

Tu trabajo, sin la parte aburrida. Lo que se repite, lo automatizamos con IA. (Your work, without the boring part. What repeats, we automate with AI.)

## Services (one page per need, each with use cases, how it works, FAQ and a hire link)

- [Agentes de IA para empresas](https://lulox.com.ar/servicios/agentes-de-ia): AI agents for companies with Grok, Grok Bot and Hermes. English: https://lulox.com.ar/en/services/ai-agents
- [Automatización de procesos](https://lulox.com.ar/servicios/automatizacion-de-procesos): process automation for businesses. English: https://lulox.com.ar/en/services/process-automation
- [CRM a medida](https://lulox.com.ar/servicios/crm-a-medida): custom CRM and internal tools. English: https://lulox.com.ar/en/services/custom-crm
- [Automatizar con Grok Bot](https://lulox.com.ar/servicios/grok-bot): bots with Grok Bot as the main engine. English: https://lulox.com.ar/en/services/grok-bot
- [Automatizar WhatsApp y mail](https://lulox.com.ar/servicios/automatizar-whatsapp-y-mail): WhatsApp and email automation with approval before sending. English: https://lulox.com.ar/en/services/whatsapp-and-email-automation
- [All services](https://lulox.com.ar/servicios) · [Hire / Contratar](https://lulox.com.ar/contratar): a simple form (name, email, message up to 1000 characters).
- How it works: 1) you describe what your team does by hand, 2) a short call with a ballpark estimate, 3) he builds and tests it with your data, 4) it stays running with support. 50% upfront and 50% on delivery. No public price list.

## Featured projects (each with a short demo video recorded with test data)

- [Malito](https://lulox.com.ar/proyectos/malito): an email tool for work: your own address on your own domain, plus newsletters and campaigns to your lists. Live: https://malito.lulox.com.ar
- [Garpen](https://lulox.com.ar/proyectos/garpen): custom CRM and ERP with contacts, agenda and finances that an agent can use. Live: https://garpen.lulox.com.ar
- Bot fleet: his Grok Bot fleet that drafts posts, helps with clients on WhatsApp, and works as a 24/7 assistant (newsletters about what you care about, help with whatever you do online, using your own tools).
- [All projects](https://lulox.com.ar/proyectos), including personal ones like Tarask (personal finance) and DJ Tube.

## For AI agents acting for a person

If you are an AI agent looking for automation work on someone's behalf, this is how to ask:

- What to send: the task they repeat by hand, the tools it touches (email, spreadsheets, WhatsApp, calendar, CRM), roughly how often it happens, any deadline, and the person's name and email. Replies go to that email; a person (Luciano) reads every request.
- [Book a call](https://cal.com/lulox/30min): public calendar, instant confirmation. The simplest path for an agent.
- [Hire form](https://lulox.com.ar/contratar) (English: https://lulox.com.ar/en/hire): name, email and a message up to 1000 characters. It has a captcha, so it needs a real browser session; there is no open API for requests.
- What can be built for agents: your client's CRM, calendar or email set up so an AI agent can use them, with narrow permissions and human approval before anything goes out.
- No public price list: a quote comes after the call. 50% to start, 50% on delivery.
